principle: Every public file under public/ either has a generated source mirror under /source/, or is explicitly listed below with a justification. Validation (tools/validate_source_mirrors.py) refuses to ship if a public file is neither mirrored nor excluded.

exclusion_reasons..well-known/attribution.sig: binary PGP detached signature for /.well-known/attribution.txt; a base64 mirror would not improve verifiability (recipients use the live .sig directly with gpg --verify against the published key)
exclusion_reasons.integrity.json: canonical signed trust artefact already linked at the top of /verify/ and /source/; a text mirror would duplicate the bytes without value and would itself land in the next build's integrity.json
exclusion_reasons.integrity.json.sig: binary PGP detached signature for /integrity.json; same reasoning as the live signed manifest itself — verified directly with gpg, mirror adds no inspection value
exclusion_reasons.file-metadata.json: date+size+sha256 sidecar manifest; hashed by integrity.json so the GPG signature transitively signs every value here. A /source/ mirror would close a hashing loop (mirror bytes → integrity.json → next-build file-metadata.json bytes → mirror bytes …). Verified directly by reading the live file.
exclusion_reasons.verify/verification-data.js: embeds per-route SHA-256 records read from integrity.json; mirroring would close a hashing loop (mirror bytes → integrity.json → next-build verification-data.js bytes → mirror bytes …). The live /verify/verification-data.js is itself the public source. The unversioned alias is kept so external bookmarks resolve.
exclusion_reasons.en-au/source/index.html: the /en-au/source/ catalogue page receives a generator-spliced exhaustive registry from generate_source_view.py after render; mirroring it would fold the registry's own file hashes back into the catalogue it lists, a convergence cycle. Like the root /source/ catalogue it is not itself mirrored.
exclusion_reasons.fr/source/index.html: the /fr/source/ catalogue page — same reasoning as en-au/source/index.html.
exclusion_reasons.en-au/source/view/index.html: per-language source-reader shell — reader chrome, not an editorial page; like the root /source/view/ shell it is not mirrored. It carries a build-volatile SRI for /source/view/source-view-manifest.js; mirroring would fold that hash into the manifest the shell itself verifies, an unresolvable convergence cycle.
exclusion_reasons.fr/source/voir/index.html: per-language source-reader shell — same reasoning as en-au/source/view/index.html.
exclusion_reasons.editorial/copy-review.md: Copywriter-facing review of content/en/ YAML sources — the public source itself; a /source/ mirror would duplicate.
exclusion_reasons.editorial/copy-review.html: Copywriter-facing review of content/en/ YAML sources — the public source itself; HTML mirror would duplicate.
exclusion_reasons.editorial/copy-review.docx: Copywriter-facing review of content/en/ YAML sources, DOCX export for Google Docs / external editor handoff. Binary, no mirror value.
exclusion_reasons.editorial/copy-review.pdf: Copywriter-facing review of content/en/ YAML sources, printable PDF. Binary, no mirror value.
exclusion_reasons.documentation/README.pdf: The documentation publication, rendered locally (docs/pdf/build.sh) and committed. Binary PDF; verified directly by hashing against integrity.json (its SHA-256 is shown on /documentation/), so a base64 mirror adds no inspection value.
exclusion_reasons.documentation/README.txt: Plain-text copy of the repository README — already the readable source form served at /documentation/README.txt; a /source/ text mirror would duplicate it byte-for-byte.
exclusion_reasons.verify/verification-data.????-??-??.*.js: Versioned, immutable-cached variant of verification-data.js. Same hashing-loop reason as the alias; not mirrored.
exclusion_reasons.app-enhance.????-??-??.*.js: Byte-identical immutable-cache copy of /app-enhance.js (the alias is mirrored at /source/app-enhance.js.txt). One mirror per file is enough.
exclusion_reasons.fonts-full.????-??-??.*.css: Byte-identical immutable-cache copy of /fonts-full.css (the alias is mirrored at /source/fonts-full.css.txt).
exclusion_reasons.fonts/*.woff2: proprietary Klim Type Foundry licence does not permit redistribution. Live site serves the bytes under valid commercial licence; release archives omit them per FONT-LICENSE-NOTICE.txt; base64 mirrors would constitute redistribution
exclusion_reasons.fonts/subsets/*.woff2: Same Klim licence applies to the homepage critical-path subsets generated by tools/build_font_subsets.py. The subsets remove glyphs but the byte-stream remains a derivative of the licensed source font; no public mirror, no archive inclusion.
